    • toCNFClauses

      private static List<GenPropFormulas.Clause> toCNFClauses(GenPropFormulas formula, boolean negated)
      Convert the existing generated-formula tree directly to CNF clauses. The boolean negated flag means "convert the negation of this node". This avoids constructing an exponentially larger intermediate tree.

    • compactCNF

      private static List<GenPropFormulas.Clause> compactCNF(List<GenPropFormulas.Clause> input)
      Keep CNF readable without reducing the complete formula to $true/$false. - duplicate literals are already removed by Clause - duplicate clauses are removed - tautological clauses are removed when non-tautological clauses remain - if every clause is tautological, retain one representative clause - clauses subsumed by a smaller clause are removed

    • run

      private GenPropFormulas.SZSonto run(Set<String> stmts, StringBuilder filename) throws Exception
      Write all the strings in @param stmts to a new file. Run vampire to prove whether each string is a tautology, contradiction or satisfiable.
      Parameters:
      filename - is a side effect that contains the filename on exit. The system searches for a filename that doesn't exist already.
      Returns:
      a selection from the TPTP SZS ontology of contradiction, saturation or "other"
      Throws:
      Exception

      public static void populateCachedFormulas()
